Select exact IC50 activities in nM for compounds tested against human BTK (CHEMBL5251) that have a canonical SMILES and a PubMed ID or DOI. Use the join path molecule_dictionary -> compound_structures -> activities -> assays -> target_dictionary, with a LEFT JOIN to docs for provenance. Return all requested columns: compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Keep every qualifying activity row without deduplication. Sort by the full requested column list.
